program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const m = inputs.mass; const t = time; const v = u - g * t; const y = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const a = -g; const F = m * g; const apexTime = u / g; const apexHeight = (u * u) / (2 * g); let stateText = "Rising"; if (Math.abs(v) < 0.05) { stateText = "At the top"; } else if (v < 0) { stateText = y <= 0.05 ? "Back at launch height" : "Falling"; } else if (t === 0) { stateText = "Ready to toss"; } const lane1 = sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 20, w: 280, h: 360, title: "The motion", state: stateText }); const axisY = sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 50, y: 350, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" }); const ballY = 50 + 280 * (y / 2.2); const ballObj = sdk.circle("ball.toss", 120, 350 - ballY, 24, { role: "observed" }); const vecV = sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 120, y: 350 - ballY }, { value: v, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" }); const vecA = sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 145, y: 350 - ballY }, { value: a, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" }); const callout = sdk.callout(165, 330 - ballY, [`v: ${v.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${a.toFixed(1)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${F.toFixed(1)} N`], { role: "observed" }); const points = []; const totalT = (2 * u) / g; const steps = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) { const ti = (i / steps) * totalT; const vi = u - g * ti; points.push([ti, vi]); } const plot = sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 320, y: 20, w: 300, h: 360, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: +5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points.filter(p => p[0] <= t) }] }); const note = sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 330, 360, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" }); const objects = [lane1, axisY, ballObj, vecV, vecA, callout, plot, note]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: v }, { id: "acceleration", value: a }, { id: "force", value: F }, { id: "motionState", value: stateText }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, mass: m, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, height: y, velocity: v, acceleration: a, force: F } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and force remain constant.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed vertically. At the apex, its velocity is zero while gravity continues to accelerate it downward.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
